product_summary: Website (adamfabriwerk.com, Home / About Us / Mobile Skids / Super Skids / Contact) shows a Nashik-based (D-56 MIDC Ambad) designer-manufacturer of pharmaceutical & bio-pharma process systems: Mobile Skids (5–500 l), Integrated Skids, Super Skids (5–30,000 l, shipped as fully integrated plants), Ointment & Cream Processing Systems, Liquid Oral Processing Systems, plus services (process design & engineering, manufacturing, automation, qualification/validation, project management). Applications listed: sterile solutions, IV fluids, aerosols, human insulin, serum, plasma fractions, vaccines, oncology, bacterial & cell cultures, mAb, microspheres. Equipment features: bottom-mounted high-shear magnetic mixers, CIP/SIP/DIP, PLC + HMI (21 CFR Part 11 / GAMP 5), instrumentation (volume, T, P, DO, conductivity, pH). Certifications claimed: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, ISO 14001:2015, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ASME U-Stamp.
role_hint: manufacturer (own integrated fabrication/assembly/testing facility at Nashik; no trader signs found on site — no third-party brands, no 'authorised dealer' language)
comment: Declared 847989 is broadly compatible with the core offering (machines with individual functions — process skids, mixing/blending units), so the code is not wrong, but it is imprecise: the dominant function of the advertised equipment is mixing/emulsifying/homogenising, which maps to 8479.82, while the integrated skid/plant packages and CIP/SIP units fit 8479.89. A separate line for stainless-steel process vessels (7309.00) and possibly 8419.89 for jacketed/temperature-controlled vessels is missing from the declaration — the site explicitly markets 'process vessels/yr' and vessels up to 30,000 l. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company positions itself exclusively for pharmaceutical and bio-pharmaceutical applications (sterile solutions, insulin, vaccines, mAb, cell cultures); no oil & gas or chemical-plant product line appears anywhere on the site. No product-specific HS breakdown, price lists or catalogue PDFs with part numbers were retrievable (the /products/ and ointment-cream sub-pages returned 404), so the exact HS split between 8479.82 and 8479.89 cannot be verified — all product claims here are website-based only and are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (no customs line corroboration was checked in this task). Per project rule 3, the HS imprecision is not a rejection ground: company retained, code to be corrected/expanded to 8479.82 + 8479.89 (+7309.00 for vessels).
